name: Sun-dried beef
summary: Krông Pa beef, dried and then grilled, eaten with yellow ant salt. The articles do not agree on sun or charcoal, or on which community makes the salt.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey places the beef in Krông Pa, from cattle about five to seven years old, marinated, dried in the highland sun, then grilled, pounded, and eaten with salt, lime and pepper, chili sauce, or yellow ant salt.
howToEat: The rural-tourism desk of the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism describes free-range beef cut into pieces, marinated with salt, pepper, lemongrass, chili, and forest spices, dried for one sun, grilled, torn into strands, and dipped in yellow ant salt.
That salt is forest weaver ants, lightly roasted and pounded with green chili, coarse salt, and forest leaves.

VnExpress International uses thigh and tenderloin from cattle five to seven years old, marinates with garlic, dried onion, and chili, dries the meat with charcoal until about 60 percent cooked, then sears it and tears it along the grain. It also prints an optional 15–20 minute bake.
VnExpress International’s dips are salt, lime, and pepper; chili sauce; or Ede weaver-ant salt of dry-roasted ants, chili, salt, coriander, laksa leaf, and then-len leaf.
VnExpress, 29 May 2016, cuts palm-sized pieces, keeps them chilled, and grills both sides over charcoal. The ants come from forest trees or garden trees.
The rural-tourism article says the plate began as everyday food of Jrai and Bahnar families in Gia Lai, and that packaged beef is now sold in specialty shops.
where: Krông Pa is the district Vietnam Tourism and VnExpress International name. A Pleiku street for the grilled plate is Check on arrival.
An hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: VnExpress, 29 May 2016, prints about 500,000 VND a kilogram to carry home. A plated price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Krông Pa sun-dried beef with ant salt
seoDescription: Krông Pa beef dried and grilled, with yellow ant salt. Sun, charcoal, and the salt recipe differ by article. A 2016 gift price is about 500,000 VND a kilogram.
